The simulation results show that when the load current changes from ImA to 50mA within <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1\mu\mathrm{s}$</tex>, the undershoot of the LDO output voltage is 21m V and the recovery time is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.12\mu\mathrm{s}$</tex> ‘. When the load current changes from 50mA to ImA within <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1\mu\mathrm{s}$</tex>, “the overshoot of the LDO output voltage is 12m V and the recovery time is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.10\mu\mathrm{s}$</tex> ‘.

articleTitle: A Short Circuit Detection Method for Si/SiC Hybrid Switches
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In high-power applications, silicon carbide (SiC) metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistors (MOSFETs) still lack competitiveness against silicon (Si) insulated gate bipolar transistors (IGBTs) due to higher costs and reliability issues. It is anticipated that hybrid parallel switches (HyS) combining SiC MOSFETs and Si IGBTs, which can approach the performance of SiC MOSFETs at a lower cost, will be a better choice. Advancements in SiC MOSFET technology are reducing their specific on-resistance, leading to a further decline in their short-circuit performance, which poses a greater challenge to traditional short-circuit detection and protection methods. This paper proposes a short-circuit detection method for HyS based on gate charge detection. With this method, the short-circuit duration is reduced to 200ns under hard switch fault(HSF) condition, and 300ns. under fault under load (FUL) condition.

articleTitle: Research on System Fan Shroud Used for Heat Dissipation in Graphics Units
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: To improve heat dissipation in graphics units, we propose installation of system fan shroud and verify the heat dissipation system. Firstly, system fan shroud suitable for the test computing system is made by 3-Dimensional printing, and thermal-fluid-coupled Finite Element Model is built according to computing system's geometry and material parameters. Secondly, the proposed heat dissipation system is verified by thermometer measurement and Finite Element Model calculation. Finally, influence of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P_{\max}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q_{\max}$</tex> in P-Q curve of system fans, graphics units Total Board Power, and different channelization is calculated by Finite Element Model. It is concluded that both thermal-fluid-coupled Finite Element Model and measurement consistently show “'20°C temperature drop after installation of system fan shroud; Besides, when maximum static pressure is fixed at 19 Pa, the lowest GPU temperature (51.21 °C) occurs at 34 m” /s maximum airflow volume; calculation with temperature-independent air properties show that GPU temperature is linearly related to TBP, and curve inclination <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k=0.0775$</tex>. The calculation, analysis and conclusion of our work can provide reference for heat dissipation strategies in computing systems.

articleTitle: STFT Based CNN for Interturn Short Circuit Fault Diagnosis of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In view of the difficulties in fault feature extraction under noise interference, the random selection of model hyperparameters, and the low fault recognition rate of traditional machine learning methods in the diagnosis of permanent magnet synchronous motor interturn short circuit fault, this paper proposes a convolutional neural network fault diagnosis method based on STFT. Firstly, the current signal of the motor in fault state is collected, and the short-time Fourier transform is applied to obtain one-dimensional input to extract sufficient fault characteristics. Finally, according to the output results of the model, the fault state of the motor can be obtained, so as to realize the fault diagnosis of the three-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor. The motor current and torque signals with different short-circuit turns ratio were collected on Simulink simulation platform for experimental verification. The experimental results show that the accuracy of fault diagnosis can reach 98%.

articleTitle: An Enhanced-Precision Bandgap Reference Incorporating Temperature-Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In this work, an Enhanced-Precision Bandgap Reference Incorporating Temperature-Compensation was proposed. Unlike traditional bandgap references, the reference voltage output of 0.701 V is realized by combining reference current and resistor. Meanwhile, an innovative Linear-piecewise current compensation was proposed, which aimed at optimizing the temperature drift of the bandgap reference. The simulation results shows that the proposed curvature-compensation technique improves the TC from 24.96 to 2.14 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{ppm}/^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> in the temperature range of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$-40 \ {}^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$120 \ {}^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex>; the PSRR of Enhanced-Precision Bandgap Reference at low frequency is 72.40 dB; the line regulation is about 0.08 %/V for input voltages between 3.2 and 3.7 V in standard 0.18 μm 1P6M CMOS process. The proposal of this new circuit provides a new idea for the realization of high- performance integrated circuits in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Private Network Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: Based on the technical characteristics, radio frequency requirements, and wireless propagation environment of wireless access networks, this article uses a series of planning methods to design base station locations, base station parameter configurations, and system parameter configurations suitable for LTE 230 systems, in order to meet the requirements of network coverage, capacity, and quality.

articleTitle: Experiment and Research on Reliability Optimization of NBTI Based on 0.11 $\mu\mathrm{m}$ ULL Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: 1.5V PMOS based on the 0.11 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\mu\mathrm{m}}$</tex> ULL process technology face a reliability problem similar to the Negative Bias Temperature Instability (NBTI) of processes below 90nm due to their high opening voltage. Based on the device degradation mechanism of NBTI, the test method and judgment criteria of NBTI are calibrated, and three kinds of interface defect reduction experiments of gate-oxygen annealing, source-drain F ion implantation and ILD increase USG are designed and completed. The experimental results showed that the estimated reliable life of NBTI increased by 44.1 times to 14.9 years when all B was replaced by BF2 by adding fluorine into PMOS source, and the higher the fluorine content, the better, and three repeated validations were successfully completed.

articleTitle: Open-Circuit Fault Diagnosis of NPC Three-Level Inverter Based on WOA-VMD
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: Due to the problems of poor feature extraction and low accuracy of fault diagnosis in traditional fault diagnosis methods for inverters, the whale optimization algorithm combined with variational modal decomposition is proposed as an open circuit fault diagnosis method for inverters. The VMD is performed on the output voltage to obtain multiple IMFs, and the energy entropy value of each mode is extracted, which is used as the input of SVM and verified in the simulation platform. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively extract fault features with high classification accuracy.

articleTitle: A High-Precision Data Acquisition System Designed by Using AD7606 and LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: A high-precision multi-channel data acquisition system was designed for the data acquisition requirements of portable laboratories and signal detection. The system utilizes STM32F407ZGT6 as the control platform, LabVIEW as the display interface, and AD7606 as the core component. Briefly, the system contains a host computer (upper computer) and a slave device (lower computer). The lower computer consists of data processing module, data acquisition one, serial communication one, and power one. For the host computer the user interface is developed by LabVIEW. The data acquisition employs the 16-bit 8-channel sampling chip AD7606. The serial communication is designed to swap data for the host computer. As a test measuring, a system measuring voltage of ±10V and current of 40mA has an error of less than 0.3%. The result directly demonstrates that the system satisfies the initial design requirements.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of α-Ga2O3 Lateral Schottky Barrier Diodes with Field Plate Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: Ga203 is considered to be an excellent material for fabricating high-voltage tolerant power devices due to its ultra-wide bandwidth. A high-voltage tolerant lateral <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha-\text{Ga}_{2}\mathrm{O}_{3}$</tex> Schottky diode (SBD) with a reverse breakdown voltage (VBR) of 1826 V has been simulated by incorporating a field plate structure with a 7 um field plate (FP) and a 500 nm <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SiO}_{2}$</tex> oxide layer. The parameters affecting the voltage withstand characteristics are analyzed, and the length of the FP, the thickness of the oxide layer and the material are investigated. As the LFP increases, the VBR increases towards saturation. This is attributed to the shift of the peak E-field towards the edge of the field plate. In addition, the increase in VBR is attributed to the ability of materials with thicker oxide layers and higher dielectric constants to support the E-field. This enhancement drives the E-field to concentrate at the edges of the FP and Schottky contact regions. These results suggest that lateral <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha-\text{Ga}_{2}\mathrm{O}_{3}$</tex> SBDs have great potential for future power electronics applications.

articleTitle: High-Performance Two-Port SRAM Design and Optimization Based on 12nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: This article introduces a fully custom design of a high-performance, two-port <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$128\mathrm{x}128$</tex> -bit SRAM, utilizing a l2nm process for microprocessor applications. To achieve objectives of high speed, low power consumption, and robust read-write stability, the two-port SRAM circuit was entirely redesigned. Following the circuit design, a comprehensive custom layout was developed, and simulations were conducted to evaluate the read-write functionality, speed, and power consumption. The design operates within a voltage range of 0.6V -1.1 V and a frequency range of 1.2GHz-l.8GHz, covering an area of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$5319.9\text{um}^{\wedge}2$</tex>, At a standard operating voltage of IV, the power is 8.luW/Mhz and demonstrates overall superior performance compared to previous designs.

articleTitle: A New Structure and Process Method for SiC Trench MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new device structure, fabrication process, and TCAD simulation for a SiC Trench MOSFET. Through utilizing a trench refill process with a controlled flow rate of hydrogen chloride (HCl) gas reported before, we can achieve a thin lateral thickness in the p-connect layer and a new structure of SiC Trench MOSFET, without using ion implantation. When the device is under reverse bias, the parasitic PMOS turn-on effectively clamps the p-connect and p-bottom regions, providing robust protection for the gate oxide corners. TCAD simulation reveals that the lateral thickness of the p-connect layer should be maintained below 400Å. The SiC Trench MOSFET demonstrates the capability to block a reverse bias voltage of 1174V, with the n-drift layer having a minimum thickness of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$7\mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> beneath the p-bottom region.

articleTitle: CPLD-Based Measurement of FPGA Boot Time
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of difficulty in testing and observing the boot time of embedded devices, a method based on CPLD is proposed to accurately measure the boot time of various types of embedded devices (FPGA, MCU, DSP, etc.). The method improves the reliability and accuracy of boot time measurement by eliminating the false judgment caused by unstable state through pulse debouncing at the measuring end and pulse delay output at the measured end. In this paper, the traditional double-pulse measurement method is improved by using EPM570T100C5 as the measurement chip, and XC7Z020CLG400-2 as the measured chip as an example to accurately measure the boot time, and its measurement accuracy can reach the nanosecond level.

articleTitle: Preparation and Properties of $\text{Ga}2\mathrm{O}_{3}$ Thin Films by Sol-Gel Method
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: Gallium oxide <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\text{Ga}_2\mathrm{O}_{3})$</tex> is a promising wide-bandgap semiconductor with a 4.9 eV bandgap, making it suitable for advanced power electronics and UV solar-blind photodetectors. Our research focuses on <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta-\text{Ga}_{2}\mathrm{O}_{3}$</tex> thin films fabricated using a cost-effective sol-gel method. We find that higher precursor concentrations optimize film quality, as indicated by improved crystallinity and reduced grain size variability. X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis showed that the crystallinity of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta-\text{Ga}2\mathrm{O}3$</tex> film increased, the grain size increased, and the full width at half maximum (FWHM) decreased by selecting the appropriate precursor concentration. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) serves as a primary tool for examining the elemental composition and surface topography of the samples. Complemented by energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS), a sophisticated analytical technique, we further delineate the elemental profiles of the samples with precision. The synergy of SEM and EDS provides a comprehensive assessment of the sample characteristics, ensuring accurate determination of their elemental constituents. The ultraviolet-visible (UV-Vis) spectrophotometer, an instrument of high precision, is utilized in this study to ascertain the spectral properties of samples within the ultraviolet to visible light spectrum. Specifically, it measures sample transmittance and absorptivity, from which the optical band gap is calculated.

articleTitle: A Physically Analytical Hybrid Model for P-GaN/AlGaN/GaN HEMTs
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: A physically analytical hybrid model is proposed for p-GaN/AlGaN/GaN high electron mobility transistors (HEMTs) in this paper. The model is developed by analyzing the relationship between the 2-D electron gas and the potential drop across each layer. It considers the doping effects and physical mechanisms of the p-GaN gate, and combines them with the core drain current model from the Advanced SPICE Model for GaN devices (ASM-GaN) to derive the analytical equation for drain current. Furthermore, the nonlinear capacitance is characterized using a current-controlled current source, leading to an analytical function describing the relationship between the nonlinear capacitance and voltage. The model is implemented using Verilog-A and extract model parameters in ICCAP. Comparison between test data and simulated data demonstrates fitting curve errors of within 4% for DC characteristics and 0.6% for dynamic capacitance models, confirming the accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Multi -Modality Joint Localization Method for Magnetic Sources Based on Tensor Invariants
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: The tensor invariant based positioning method has a broad application prospect in the detection field due to its insensitivity to attitude changes. However, the traditional method, which uses the gradient direction of tensor invariants as the target vector direction, is limited by non-spherical errors, resulting in low positioning accuracy. This paper proposes a new joint positioning method. By analyzing rotational invariants unaffected by relative attitude, and combining the total field gradient magnitude of the magnetic target with tensor contraction quantities, we obtain the real-time relative distance from the target to the measurement point center. This approach achieves multipoint joint positioning in various application scenarios. It effectively overcomes the non-spherical error issues present in traditional methods, significantly reduces the structural complexity of the magnetometer, and retains the advantage of tensor rotational invariants being less affected by attitude changes. Experimental results show that this method can achieve high-precision real-time positioning of magnetic anomaly targets under low signal-to-noise ratio conditions, demonstrating significant engineering application value.

articleTitle: Low-Temperature Drift Oscillator Design for Multi-Cell Lithium Battery Packs
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In the battery management chip, in order to save power consumption, an RC relaxation oscillator is used. In view of the large temperature coefficient and high power consumption of traditional RC oscillators, this paper designs a low-temperature drift relaxation oscillator for multi-cell lithium battery packs. The oscillator consists of a start-up module, an RC charge and discharge module, and a reference source module. The zero temperature coefficient current is used to charge and discharge the capacitor, and the critical voltages V Hand V L that can be reached by charging and discharging the capacitor are clamped by controlling the on-off of the MOSFET in parallel with the resistor, instead of using a traditional voltage comparator to compare the capacitor voltage with the reference voltage, thus greatly simplifying the circuit structure and reducing the temperature coefficient and power consumption of the circuit. At the tt process angle of 3.3V power supply voltage and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$</tex>, the oscillation frequency of the output signal is 32.85kHz, the average power consumption of the circuit is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$10.94_{\mu}\mathrm{W}$</tex>, and the frequency temperature coefficient at this process angle is 58.45 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{ppm}/^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Effect of OFET based on P3HT:PVK Active Layer Blending on its Electrical Performance and $\text{NO}_{2}$ Gas Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: OFET has been widely used in gas sensor field because of its advantages of low cost and large area preparation. The OFETs of a single active layer are not highly responsive to gas, therefore this paper takes PVK and P3H<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$T$</tex> blends as active layers, and tests the electrical characteristics and gas sensitivity of OFET with different blending ratios. When the PVK: P3H<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$T$</tex> blend ratio is 50wt.%, the carrier mobility increases from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.0061\text{cm}^{2}/\text{Vs}$</tex> to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.027\text{cm}^{2}/\text{Vs}$</tex> by 4.43 times, and the threshold voltage decreases from 29.46V to 23.01V. NO2 sensing performance at 20ppm was also tested. When the PVK: P3HT blend ratio is 100wt. %, OFET has a higher response of 209%, and the NO2 response of the blended device is 4.75 times higher than that of the unblended device.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent Transmitter for Non Electrical Signals based on Sensor Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In order to understand the design of intelligent transmitters for non electrical signals based on sensor acquisition, a research on the design of intelligent transmitters for non electrical signals based on sensor acquisition has been proposed. This paper first designs a multivariable transmitter that can simultaneously collect pressure, vibration, temperature, and noise. In order to facilitate long-distance and low loss transmission of the voltage signals output by the four sensors, the voltage signals are linearly converted into industrial standard 3–30 mA analog signals for transmission; Secondly, in order to solve the common problem of multiple signals interfering with each other in multivariable transmitters, a modular design concept was adopted; Finally, the experiment shows that the conversion error of this multivariable transmitter for pressure signals is less than 0.12%, the conversion error for vibration signals is less than 1.3%, the conversion error for noise signals is less than 0.22%, and the conversion error for temperature signals is less than 0.43%; And it has a simple structure, high reliability, and strong practicality and universality.

articleTitle: Research on the Reliability of Gallium Oxide Power Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern semiconductor technology, silicon and germanium no longer meet people's needs, and more and more broadband forbidden semiconductors have been proposed. Among them, gallium oxide, as a new type of ultra wide bandgap semiconductor material, has outstanding advantages such as wider energy band, higher critical breakdown electric field, and lower production cost compared to third-generation semiconductors gallium nitride and silicon carbide. This has attracted great attention from the scientific and industrial communities in the field of ultra-high voltage withstand power electronic devices. However, due to the material and electronic structure of gallium oxide, there are a series of reliability issues in its power devices. Among them, due to the poor thermal conductivity of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta$</tex>-Ga2O3, gallium oxide MOSFET may be affected by self heating effects. Similar to other wide bandgap oxide semiconductors, achieving p-type doping of gallium oxide is difficult. Due to the material, gallium oxide MOSFET cannot reach their theoretical breakdown voltage. This article proposes three main issues that affect the reliability of gallium oxide MOSFET, and identifies methods that can be optimized at each stage to address these three issues.

articleTitle: High-Speed Data Writing Strategy Based on Error Weight Mapping
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) perform well in the fields of image recognition, natural language processing, etc. As the device of choice for neuromorphic computing, memristor has the advantages of integrated storage and computation, non-volatility, simple structure, low power consumption, and high storage density. And it plays an important role in accelerating the computation speed of neural networks. However, there is a huge challenge when performing convolutional neural network computation based on memristor: the multi value precise writing of memristors is slow. This will lead to difficulties in achieving fast Network algorithm deployment and computation of neural networks. This paper focuses on memristor-based convolutional neural network computation and proposes a method for fast multivalued mapping of memristor through reducing the multi-value writing accuracy of the memristor moderately, compared with the traditional multi-value full precision writing strategy, which can achieve less than half of the overall data writing time. This work hold great promise for applications that rely on high writing speed.

articleTitle: A Long-life Flexible Pressure-Temperature Composite Sensor with High Accuracy and Stability
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: A long-life flexible temperature-pressure composite sensor based on composite conductive material is introduced in this work. The composite conductive material which combines carbon nanoparticles and silicone rubber in liquid phase method is used as the pressure sensitive unit. The results show that the flexible pressure sensor has accuracies of 99.2% and 99% when measuring pressure and position respectively. The encapsulation layers made of PDMS and PE films isolate the sensing units from air and vapor, and can extend the life of the sensor ten times larger than that without encapsulation layer. The experimental result shows the excellent stability, sensitivity, and reusability after 70 days' test. Nano-silver temperature sensor fabricated in electrostatic printing technology was introduced on the surface of the pressure sensor in order to eliminate the resistance-changing caused by the temperature.

articleTitle: A Deep Unfolding Network Algorithm for TomoSAR Building Object Height Inversion
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: TomoSAR building object height inversion is to utilize the two-dimensional radar image data obtained by a spacecraft such as a satellite that has sailed over a building several times to invert the position of the building scatterer distribution in the height direction, which is essentially a sparse reconstruction problem. The deep unfolding network algorithm ALISTA is a frontier algorithm for solving sparse reconstruction problems, which is a deep neural network algorithm obtained by combining the Iterative Soft Thresholding Algorithm (1STA) and Deep Learning, and possesses the advantages of both at the same time. The ALISTA-Polyak algorithm can be obtained by adding the Polyak heavy ball acceleration term to the iterative format of ALISTA, and this algorithm improves ALISTA at the level of first-order optimization algorithm. In this paper, on the basis of this algorithm, a densely connected network structure is introduced, and the ALISTA-Polyak algorithm is further improved at the level of deep neural network, and the DBALISTA-Polyak algorithm is obtained. The experimental results demonstrate that the inversion performance of the improved algorithm is superior to that of ALISTA and ALISTA-Polyak under the condition of restricted observation data.

articleTitle: Shallow Trench Design for Silicon Carbide Planar-Gate MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: To achieve efficient utilization of power devices, reducing on-resistance and enhancing switching characteristics have always been key research focuses in the field of power devices. Currently, shrinking the cell size of planar MOSFETs is no longer effective in significantly reducing on-resistance, while trench MOSFETs, although they lower the specific on-resistance, introduce reliability issues. This paper investigates the traditional planar SiC MOSFET structure by etching a portion of the JFET region to form a shallow trench-planar MOSFET(STP-MOS), which aims to reduce the device's characteristic on-resistance. The static characteristics of the STP-MOS are analyzed through simulations to determine the impact of different trench depths and widths. A comparison is made between the static and dynamic characteristics of the planar-gate MOSFET and the STP-MOS. According to the results, the reverse breakdown voltage of the STP-MOS is increased by 0.3% compared to the planar-gate MOSFET, while the characteristic on-resistance of the STP-MOS is reduced by 10.17% under the same structural parameters. The gate-drain capacitance (CGD) of the STP-MOS is decreased by 28.57% compared to the planar-gate MOSFET.

articleTitle: Failure Analysis of VDMOS Devices in High Power Test
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: Power VDMOS devices are vertical double diffused structure devices and are the mainstream devices in power semiconductors today. Steady state power life test is one of the main methods to verify its ability to withstand high power for a long time. Currently, there is relatively little research on the failure of VDMOS devices in steady-state tests. This article analyse N-channel VDMOS devices that have failed after steady-state power life testing. Through investigating test conditions and equipment, static retesting, thermal impedance analysis, chip visual inspection, and other methods, the failed samples are analyzed, and the main reasons for their failure are summarized. Improvement measures have been verified to be effective. This provides reference data for subsequent analysis of related types of failures and methodological support for conducting high-power steady-state life tests on VDMOS devices.

articleTitle: ADRC Parameters Tuning Based on MPGA for Radar Servo System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: When the radar servo system tracks the maneuvering target, its platform is susceptible to gust disturbance and other effects on the tracking accuracy. The active disturbance rejection control technology can achieve high tracking accuracy and anti-interference. However, it also has some problems, such as many parameters to be adjusted, difficult manual adjustment and difficult to achieve optimal control effect. In this regard, this paper proposed a parameters optimization method based on multi-population genetic algorithm to intelligently tune the parameters of the active disturbance rejection controller. The simulation results show that the active disturbance rejection controller with the parameters adjusted by the intelligent algorithm can make the radar servo system have faster tracking effect and better anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: A New 8T SRAM Cell Design of Low-Power and High-Write-Speed
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In this paper, a low-power 8T cell structure with high writing ability is proposed. The proposed SRAM basic cell circuit eliminates the write-1 issue by adding two PMOS transistors, resulting in a faster write speed for the cell structure. This design achieves a larger write margin without the need for additional circuits. The results show that, compared to other SRAM cells, the proposed SRAM cell has satisfactory performance in terms of power consumption, write margin, and read access time.

articleTitle: Detection of on-State Impedance Based on High-Frequency Current Injection Method
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: SiC (Silicon Carbide) MOSFETs are replacing Si IGBTs in the future for its advantages of high power, high frequency and high efficiency. Although the reliability of SiC MOSFET remains an important issue. In all electrical parameters, the on-resistance will indicates directly the wealth of MOSFET, including aging, junction temperature and packing failure. Online monitoring of devices on resistance is becoming increasingly important. In this paper, a method for detecting on-state impedance based on high frequency current injection is proposed. In a certain frequency range, the real part of the on-resistance is equal to the on-state resistance, and the virtual part is a constant value, which can reflect the same information as the on-resistance. The experimental results show that the measurement error is less than 10%.

articleTitle: Target Recognition Algorithm Based on Double Contour Feature Matching
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In this paper, a target recognition algorithm based on double contour feature matching is proposed. When the algorithm faces the shape of an object with nonlinear deformation (occlusion and noise), it is difficult to match and the error matching rate is high. Firstly, the effective segment of the shape is obtained, and the feature points of the segment are obtained by uniform sampling. Then, the similarity of the centroid height function between the contour points of the contour segment is measured by dynamic regularization algorithm, and the confidence characteristics of the contour segment are calculated. Finally, the segmentation confidence is combined to match and identify again. The experimental results show that this method has high shape classification accuracy when dealing with nonlinear deformation.

articleTitle: Investigation of Buffer Profile Influence on Short-Circuit Behaviour of MPT-FS IGBT
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: The differences in short-circuit characteristics of MPT-FS IGBT devices with various profile of backside buffer layers formed by proton implant and low temperature anneal are compared, the mechanism of short-circuit turn-off failure of the device is analyzed, and it is verified that the short-circuit oscillation phenomenon occurs in the MPT-FS IGBT devices with relatively low bipolar current gain of the collector-side p-n-p transistor, and that, for a specific FS buffer layer, the short-circuit duration of the MPT-FS IGBT device can be improved by increasing the back-side p-collector dose.

articleTitle: A Ultra High Frequency Miniaturized Wideband Vivaldi Antenna Design
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In this paper, a compact wideband Vivaldi antenna for airborne electronic warfare (EW) applications is presented with experimental results. The antenna is fed by a microstrip-slotline balun with operational frequency range from 0.35 to 0.8GHz. This novel design employ both tapered slot edge (TSE) and resistance-loading technology to effectively reduce antenna aperture. The final antenna size is only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$170\text{mm}\times 185\text{mm}\times 1.6\text{mm}$</tex> (without coaxial connector) with measured <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{gain}\geq-3\text{dB},\text{VSWR}\leq 2.2$</tex> and 3dB beamwidth between 50° and 115°. Besides, radiation patterns at various frequencies are in good consistence which also fulfills passive direction finding (DF) array design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on the Effect of Heating Temperature Rise on the Reliability of CSOP Solder Joints
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: To study the effect of heating temperature rise on the reliability of device solder joints, a typical Ceramic Small Outline Package (CSOP) device was selected. A test board was designed and the actual temperature rise of the CSOP devices during the temperature cycling test was obtained through experiments. To compare the thermal fatigue life of the CSOP devices under powered and unpowered conditions, finite element simulation models were established. The maximum stress value and maximum strain value under two conditions were compared and studied. The research results show that the heating temperature rise when devices are powered on has an impact on the reliability of CSOP devices solder joints.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on the Normal Avalanche Breakdown and Delayed Avalanche Breakdown for 10kV 4H-SiC FID
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In this paper, the comparative study between the normal avalanche breakdown and delayed avalanche breakdown for lOkV 4H-SiC Fast Ionization Device is experimented by numerical simulation methods. A 4H-SiC traditional asymmetric thyristor with the forward blocking voltage of lOkV, the static breakdown and the pulse triggering circuits are adapted. The distribution of electric field, the carrier's density and impact ionization rate between NAB and DAB are compared by the simulator. The results show that the differences between them are uniformity of the electric field distribution, background carriers' density and the rate of impact ionization. This may be attributed to the variation of effective charge density in the base region.

articleTitle: Layout Design and Fabrication a 386% Improved SOA 100V SGT MOSFET for Linear Mode Application
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: Advanced gate shielded trench (SGT) power MOSFET has a narrow pitch and short channel resulting in poor linear mode performance. In order to solve this problem, wide SOA cell is proposed to integrated into the advanced SGT MOSFETs for improving its linear mode capability. The fabricated l00V SGT MOSFET has a specific on-resistance Rsp of 28 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{m}\Omega-\text{mm}^{2}$</tex>. In TO-220 package, HYG0l8Nl0NSlP has Rdson(l0V) of 2.2 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{m}\Omega$</tex>, and BVdss of l08V. Its SOA has been improved 386% from 2.8A to l0.8A at the test condition of Vgs=l0V, Vds=48V, PT=10mSec, Im=l0mA, after the integration of wide SOA cells into the original device structure. There is no increase in Idss and Igss leakage with the wide SOA cell integration. The new fabrication process is compatible to the traditional SGT MOSFET process flow. This approach can be applied to SGT and trench MOSFETs for its SOA improvement in any range of breakdown voltage.

articleTitle: Research on the Visual Measurement Method of Inductance Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: Inductors have many parameters, of which the two most important parameters determine the performance of the inductor: inductance and saturation current. The existing inductance parameter measurement methods can either measure the inductance value more accurately or use other auxiliary means to measure the saturation current, but they cannot measure the inductance value and the saturation current at the same time. A simple resistance inductance series measurement circuit is designed by combining the special single trigger and graphic display technology of digital storage oscilloscope. According to the measurement definition of inductance value, measure the voltage value at both ends of the inductance and the current change value of the sampling resistor to calculate the inductance value. The digital storage oscilloscope displays the inflection point of the measurement curve, and the inductor saturation current can be calculated. It is verified by experiments that this method can obtain accurate inductance values and at the same time obtain intuitive saturation current values. The method is simple in principle, reasonable in design, and easy to operate. It is an economical and effective method for measuring inductance parameters in the absence of an LCR tester in the laboratory.

articleTitle: Study on Breakdown Mechanism and Dynamic Avalanche of SGT MOSFET with Trench Termination
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: The termination structure of SGT MOSFET is related to the breakdown voltage and avalanche ruggedness. The trench termination is introduced into SGT MOSFET, and the breakdown mechanism and dynamic avalanche are studied and analyzed in this paper, which can optimize the distribution of electric field strength at the termination region, improve the voltage withstand stability and avalanche ruggedness of SGT MOSFET.

articleTitle: The Effect of the Doping Concentration in the Anode Region on the Voltage Temperature Coefficient of the FRD Chips
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: Fast Recovery Diode chips are widely used in power systems, often employed in reverse parallel packages with Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor chips. Due to the growing demand for increased power system equipment capacity, there has been a corresponding rise in the requirement for the amount of FRD chips in IGBT devices. Consequently, the issue of parallel current evenness of FRD chips has garnered greater attention. Traditional FRD chips exhibit a negative voltage temperature coefficient, which can result in “current-heat” negative feedback due to uneven current distribution when operated in parallel and may lead to chip failure under severe conditions. To address this problem, a method is presented in this paper to optimize the forward voltage temperature coefficient of FRD chips by analyzing carrier concentration distribution and mobility distribution within the drift region through establishing FRD chip simulation models. This method involves reducing the anode doping concentration as a means of regulating the voltage temperature coefficient of FRD chips. Based on this approach, the 3300V 1125A FRD chips are fabricated and tested. It demonstrates less than 15% deviation between measured results and simulated results for room temperature forward voltage, high temperature forward voltage and voltage temperature coefficient, thereby validating the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Breakdown Voltage and Specific on-Resistance of SOI LDMOS with an Inverted T-Shaped Oxide Trench and Highly Doped P/N Columns
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In this paper, a novel lateral double-diffused MOSFET(LDMOS) based on silicon-on-insulator (SOl) technology with an inverted T-shaped oxide trench and highly doped P/<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N$</tex> columns (ITTPN) is proposed. The new structure features an inverted T-shaped oxide trench and highly doped P/N columns. The P columns at the left of the trench help deplete the drift region. In addition, it will also cause the drift region to achieve a high doping concentration, thus reducing the specific on-resistance <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(R_{\text{on},\text{sp}})$</tex>. Furthermore, a lower resistance path for the carriers is formed owing to the highly doped N column, which can further reduce <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R_{\text{on},\text{sp}}$</tex>. The P/N columns and the inverted T-shaped oxide trench can modulate the electric field in the drift region, enhancing the breakdown voltage (BV). Based on the simulation, compared with the conventional trench SOl LDMOS (Con-T LDMOS), the ITTPN LDMOS eventually reaches a BV of 194 V and a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R_{\text{on},\text{sp}}$</tex> of 2.76 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{m}\Omega\cdot \text{cm}^{2}$</tex>. which are improved by 56% and 73%, respectively; at the same time, the figure of merit (FOM) is 13.64 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{MW}/\text{cm}^{2}$</tex>, which is an improvement of 803%.

articleTitle: Simulation and Optimization of 4H-SiC LDMOS Devices with Field Limiting Ring Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: Field Limiting Ring (FLR) termination structures are widely used in semiconductor power devices due to their significant improvement in breakdown voltage. A simulation model of 4H-SiC LDMOS with an FLR structure was established using numerical simulation software. The effects of the number of FLRs and the doping concentration of FLRs on the breakdown characteristics and transfer characteristics were simulated. The surface electric field at device breakdown was extracted and analyzed in terms of the uniformity of surface electric field distribution and the peak electric field. The simulation results show that with the increase in the number of FLRs, the breakdown voltage of the device increases. However, when the FLRs are too close to the drain, the breakdown voltage decreases. Additionally, as the doping concentration of the FLRs increases, the breakdown voltage first increases and then decreases.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanism and ESD Protection Characteristics of a Novel DP_DDSCR with Low Trigger Voltage
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In this paper., a novel bidirectional electrostatic discharge (ESD) protection device., called DP _DDSCR (Direction Silicon-Controlled Rectifier with embedded lateral PNP transistors) presented as a solution to rectify the high trigger voltage issue found in conventional DDSCR (Direction Silicon-Controlled Rectifier) The proposed DP _DDSCR structure is an improvement upon the traditional DDSCR., embedding two symmetrical P+ region. The current transport mechanism of the new device is analyzed., with particular attention given to the improvement mechanism of electrostatic protection characteristics due to the introduction of symmetrical P+ regions. The embedded P+ regions and N -well in the new structure create a parasitic PNP transistor that forms an auxiliary trigger path., improving upon the high trigger voltage issue found in traditional DDSCR devices., which rely on the avalanche effect of the reverse-biased PN junction between wells. The parasitic PNP transistor acts as a current discharge path., working with the main SCR to discharge current after the device is triggered., which improves the efficiency of current discharge. The static electrical characteristics and transient performance of the new DP _DDSCR device structure are analyzed based on TLP (Transmission Line Pulsing) and VF-TLP (Very-Fast TLP) test and simulation methods. The testing result show that., compared to traditional DDSCR., the trigger voltage of DP _DDSCR decreases by 44.9%., and the ESD design window is optimized by 50.4%. Furthermore., the new structure demonstrates a significant decrease in overshoot voltage., along with superior heat dissipation capability and turn-on speed.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Drip Alarm System Based on 51 Single-Chip Microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: The acquisition, analysis and control of sensing signals are important fundamental aspects of embedded design. With the continuous progress of embedded technology, the application of alarm system based on single-chip microcomputer has developed from simplification to diversification. However, there is still a lack of monitoring means for medical equipment usage. This paper studies the workflow of the common drip system in the hospital, and designs and implements a wireless drip alarm system based on infrared drip sensor module, 51 single-chip microcomputer system module and SIM800 C instruction module. This system adopts drip alarm based on infrared sensor and 51 single chip microcomputer. The infrared sensor module monitors the working of the solution dripper and warns the possible risks through the buzzer module, while the alarm information can be automatically sent to the cell phone of relevant personnel by SIM800C module. Compared to traditional capacitive sensor methods based on contact with liquids, alarm systems using infrared sensor modules do not contaminate solutions, are simple to operate, reduce potential health risks to patients due to infusion problems, and reduce the cost of the alarm system.

articleTitle: A New Control Strategy for Improving the Voltage Quality of Inverter Grid Connected System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: A Bayesian regularization neural network control strategy has been proposed to address the impact of changes in grid impedance on the output voltage amplitude and frequency of inverter grid connected systems, given an ideal SVPWM input voltage. The LCL type three-phase inverter grid connected system model has been built in the first step, and it has been demonstrated that a given ideal SVPWM input voltage can eliminate the influence of grid impedance changes on the common coupling point (PCC) voltage frequency of the grid connected system. Based on this, the duty cycle of the buck boost converter has been predicted through a neural network to adapt to changes in grid impedance, and direct voltage control has been achieved. Then, the performance function of the Bayesian regularization neural network has been elaborated, and the control performance of the neural network has been verified. Finally, a traditional resonant damping control system was constructed, and the performance of the proposed control strategy and traditional resonant damping control method was compared through Simulink simulation results. The experimental results show that the proposed control strategy can avoid the impact of grid impedance changes on the output voltage quality of PCC points, and expand the adaptability range of inverter grid connected systems to grid impedance changes.

articleTitle: A Low Switching Loss 4H-SiC Superjunction MOSFET Design
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In this paper, a 4H-SiC dual-trench metal-oxide-semiconductor field effect transistor with shielded-gate and superjunction (DT/SJ-SGTMOS) is proposed. Due to the shielded gate structure at the gate trench, the gate-drain overlap area of the device is reduced. The switching speed of the device is improved. In addition, the P-pillar and the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{N}^{+}$</tex>-drift form a superjunction structure, which reduces the specific on-resistance <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(R_{\text{on},\text{sp}})$</tex> and improves the breakdown voltage (BV). Compared with 4H-SiC superjunction dual-trench MOSFET (DT-SJMOS), the DT/SJ-SGTMOS has higher BV, faster switching speed, and superior dynamic and static performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Radio Wave Propagation Characteristics in Fog Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: With the advancement of science and technology, radio wave technology assumes a crucial role in all walks of life. When fog emerges, coupled with factors such as atmospheric absorption, the propagation attenuation of radio waves becomes even more severe. Hence, analyzing the propagation characteristics of radio waves in a fog environment is an important topic. By introducing parabolic equations to calculate the propagation loss of radio waves in the fog environment and considering atmospheric factors like oxygen and water content, the equivalent dielectric constant of the fog is computed using the Maxwell-Garnett formula. By setting antennas of different frequencies, the results indicate that the difference in propagation loss of low-frequency radio waves in the heavy fog environment and the standard atmosphere environment is greater than that of high-frequency radio waves. The analysis of radio wave propagation characteristics in a heavy fog environment can provide technical support and numerical references for the future radio wave propagation model in complex environments.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Wireless Mobile Node Mutilayering Network Sliding Window Routing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: A wireless self-organizing network routing algorithm suitable for energy storage wireless communication nodes has been proposed, which features adaptive node cluster construction, automatic layering, treelike topology, multi-layer network, and can be used for uninterrupted communication in location changes. In this routing algorithm, the status of each node is equal and variable, and a method of constructing a cluster of mobile communication network nodes using circular sliding windows is proposed. Each node in the algorithm can be elected as a cluster head or a gateway node to connect subnets as needed. Through simulation, the energy loss of nodes and the average end- to-end delay between nodes were calculated and compared using this method. The average end-to-end delay between nodes was reduced by 11.64% compared to GACO, and 45.2% and 50.3% compared to AODV and DSR respectively. This algorithm has superior communication persistence capability in decentralized communication networks, infrastructure free communication network scenarios., emergency communication, and military communication.

articleTitle: Application of Augmented Reality in Polarity Control During AIT Process of Satellite
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: This paper reviews the importance and universality of polarity control during AIT process of satellite. Aiming at the problem that operators have a large cognitive load of polarity information in 3D manufacturing mode, an AR platform service is established to realize the assembly guidance in various application scenarios. The typical case of application shows that the use of AR technology improves the quality and efficiency of polarity confirmation greatly during the AIT process of satellite.

articleTitle: Improvement of Dynamic Characteristic of the Etched JTE for 10kV 4H-SiC FID
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: The maximum voltage for silicon carbide (SiC) Fast Ionization Dynistor (FID) is significantly exceeds than the static blocking voltage, rendering it challenging for conventional termination to ensure the FID's normal operation. Consequently, this paper investigates and optimizes the FID with Three-Step Space-Modulated Buffer Trench junction termination extension (3S-SMBT-JTE). This terminal structure exhibits superior capability for controlling the breakdown peak surface and bulk electric fields. Simulation results indicate that, with the utilization of 3S-SMBT-JTE, the maximum voltage observed is 14.96kV, and the peak electric field strength in the termination region is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.66 \times 10^{6}\mathrm{V}/\text{cm}$</tex>, which is below the critical breakdown field strength. Compared to the traditional 3S-JTE, the 3S-2SMBT-JTE has reduced the peak electric field in the terminal region by 68.03%.

articleTitle: Parameter Convergent Ridge Regression Algorithm for Digital Predistortion Model
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: The least squares estimation algorithm is widely used in the parameter extraction of digital predistortion model in power amplifier linearization technology. However, there is a strong correlation between the input and output signals of the actual power amplifier, which makes the ill-conditioned matrix that leads to large errors appear in the parameter extraction of model, thus reducing the linearization performance of the digital predistortion. In order to address the issue mentioned above, a parameter convergence ridge regression (PCRR) algorithm based on digital predistortion model is proposed in this paper. The selection of ridge parameters is determined by the convergence of the actual model parameters, so as to improve the linearity of the output signal of power amplifier. Furthermore, by introducing the ridge parameters, the ill-conditioned matrix is avoided in the least squares estimation algorithm. In order to verify the algorithm proposed in this paper, we carry out simulation test and experimental verification. The experimental conditions are 16 QAM signals with 20 MHz bandwidth. The digital predistortion model adopts the decomposition vector rotation model, and the parameter convergence value is 1. The simulation results show that the proposed method improves the adjacent channel power suppression ratio of the power amplifier output signal from −31.2 dBc to −53.03 dBc, which is 2 dBc higher than that of the least squares algorithm. The experimental results show that the proposed method improves the adjacent channel power suppression ratio of the power amplifier output signal from −35.39 dBc to −57 dBc, which is 0.6 dBc higher than that of the least squares algorithm. Therefore, the proposed algorithm can avoid the occurrence of ill-conditioned matrix in parameter extraction and improve the linearization effect of power amplifier output signal.

articleTitle: MSANet: Congestion Prediction for Chip Routing Based on Multi-Scale Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: Placement and routing are the most time-consuming parts of the chip design process. Reducing routing congestion is crucial for optimizing placement and improving routability. However, existing congestion prediction models cannot fully utilize the feature information of the chip placement during the prediction process, leading to low prediction accuracy. Therefore, this paper proposes a new multi-scale perception convolutional neural network, called MSAN et, to extract and fully utilize the rich multi-scale feature information from chip placement diagrams, thereby improving the accuracy of predicting routing congestion hotspots. To sufficiently demonstrate the prediction ability of the proposed MSAN et, we conduct extensive experimental validation on two publicly classical datasets. The experimental results show that MSAN et achieves a 46.5% improvement over the existing state-of-the-art methods on the ISPD2015 benchmark dataset, which demonstrates the strong effectiveness of the proposed multi-scale attention mechanisms and shortcut operations of the MSAN et. Moreover, on the large-scale CircuitN et dataset, our MSAN et achieve a 7.1 % improvement compared to the original model, demonstrated the superiority of our approach.

articleTitle: Design of 3dB Lange Coupler with Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: This paper designs <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$a\ \boldsymbol{90^{\mathrm{o}}}$</tex> 3dB Lange coupler with low over-coupling and low return loss. The coupling line width and coupling line spacing of the Lange coupler are preliminarily cal-culated through traditional design methods. This coupler has an over-coupling situation. This paper considers the influence of the thickness of the coupled microstrip line itself and calculates the compensation amount. Finally, the deviation of the coupler's cou-pling degree and through degree from 3dB does not exceed 0.ldB in 2.8~3.6GHz.

articleTitle: Temperature Compensation Method and Embedded System Design for MEMS Accelerometers
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: The tethered underwater profiler utilizes MEMS accelerometers to detect its motion state, and the temperature change in the profiler cavity will lead to the measurement misalignment of the micro-inertial measurement unit inside the accelerometer. In this paper, we experimentally obtain the triaxial acceleration values under different attitudes <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(-90\sim 90^{\circ})$</tex> with temperature <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(25\sim 50^{\circ}\mathrm{C})$</tex>, and establish the multivariate linear fitting model, the BP neural network model, and the PSO-BP neural network model after the experimental data are processed by low-pass filtering, respectively. The embedded system is designed to write the temperature compensation model of the accelerometer into the microcontroller STM32F103 for operation and output the compensated results. The R-value of the BP model and the PSO-BP model are both 1, the three-axis RMSEs of the multivariate linear fitting model are 1.02, 0.927, and 6.2, and that of the three-axis RMSEs of the BP model are 0.1293, 0.0229, 0.0156, and the three-axis RMSE of the PSO-BP model is 0.0576, 5.1297e-5, 0.0031, respectively. The experimental results show that the PSO-BP model has a good effect of compensating the temperature drift error of the accelerometers, and can effectively reduce the measurement error of the MEMS accelerometers introduced by the temperature change and improve the performance of the tethered accelerometers. Measurement error and improve the measurement accuracy of the inertial measurement unit measurement of the bollarded underwater profiler.

articleTitle: MATLAB Simulation of UAV 3D Path Planning Research Based on ACO Algorithm, Astar Algorithm and RRT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: UAVs have a wide range of applications in industrial engineering. Three-dimensional path planning is one of the key directions of UAV research. In this paper, the ACO algorithm, Astar algorithm and RRT algorithm are used to simulate multiple obstacles Environment. Through the comparison of simulation results, the influence of algorithm selection on the 3D path planning of UAV in multi-obstacle environment is obtained.

articleTitle: Effect of Crucible Rotational Velocity on Physical Field Distribution in 18-inch Czochralski Monocrystalline Silicon Melts
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: Using COMSOL Multiphysics simulation software, the optimal distance between the middle guide ring of the magnet and the free surface under an applied CUSP magnetic field was analyzed. Simulations were conducted to predict the distribution of the flow field, oxygen impurity concentration field, and thermal field during the growth process of an I8-inch solar-grade Czochralski monocrystalline silicon under different crucible rotation speeds. When the optimal distance is 90mm, the asymmetric CUSP magnetic field can generate a larger magnetic field strength in the main convective region, weakening the main convection and making the thermal distribution of the molten silicon more uniform. Meanwhile, the crucible rotational velocity significantly impacts the spatial distribution of the physical fields within the molten silicon. With the increase in crucible rotational velocity, melt oxygen impurity content in the region below the crystal first rises and then falls under the combined action of the melt thermal field and flow field. When the crucible rotational velocity reaches 11 revolutions per minute(rpm), the convection form that is generated is conducive to the volatilization of oxygen impurities from the free surface, resulting in a lower average oxygen impurities content near the solid-liquid interface.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Circuit Packaging Testing Technology Based on Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: The integrated circuit packaging testing technology is highly demanding, and the task is arduous. The existing sorting efficiency of integrated circuit packaging testing is low, and it is difficult to detect unqualified products for rapid centralized processing. There is an urgent need for upgrading and improvement. This paper proposes to fine-tune the large language model and establish a large language model monitoring system for integrated circuit packaging and inspection, embedding it in a CNC system, thereby providing support for the intelligent transformation and upgrading of integrated circuit production and processing.

articleTitle: Electronic Properties of Novel Two-Dimensional SixCy568
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: a new type of two-dimensional (2D) <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Si}_{X}\mathrm{C}_{\mathrm{y}}$</tex> semiconductor material with the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$sp^{2}+sp^{3}$</tex> hybridization is proposed in this paper. The crystal unit cell consists of pentagon, hexagon, and octagon rings, referred to as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\mathrm{D}-\text{Si}_{X}\mathrm{C}_{y}568$</tex>. The stability in terms of energy and dynamics as well as structure parameters and basic electronic properties of the unit cell were investigated using first-principles calculation, based on the density functional theory (DFT). The results indicate that the proposed <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\mathrm{D}\ \text{Si}_{1} \mathrm{C}_{12}568$</tex> is stable in terms of energy and dynamics, with an indirect bandgap of 0.97 e V. The conduction band minimum and the valence band maximum are located at the G and M points of the Brillouin Zone, respectively. The minimum effective mass of electrons is 0. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$44m\mathrm{o}$</tex>, it is close to the effective mass of C568, which suggests that it could be a semiconductor material with a very high mobility. The calculated result of the carriers' mobility indicates that the electron mobility is very high, reaching up to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.44\times 10^{4}\text{cm}^{2}\mathrm{s}^{-1}\mathrm{V}^{-1}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Research on Precise Positioning Technology of Staged Fracturing Sleeve Based on Geomagnetic Anomaly Marking
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In order to break through the limitation of the number of positioning stages of the traditional ball-throwing staged fracturing sliding sleeve. Based on the theory of static magnetic field and electromagnetic induction, this paper proposes a precise positioning technology of staged fracturing sleeve based on geomagnetic anomaly marking. This technology sets a high-permeability Permalloy ring group inside the casing according to a certain coding laws as a geomagnetic anomaly tag, collects the magnetic gradient change of the casing diameter through the designed geomagnetic anomaly signal acquisition system, and performs the processing of amplitude limiting amplification, filtering, Analog -to- Digital conversion, zero crossing comparison, and decoding on the collected signals, and finally recognizes the tag positioning data, so as to realize the precise positioning of fracturing sliding sleeve. The reliability of the method is verified by analyzing the magnetic field simulation and building an experimental bench for experimental verification. This technology has the advantages of natural, passive, stable and reliable, and can be widely applied to the precise positioning of fracturing sliding sleeve.

articleTitle: Influence of Stoichiometry and Surface Crystal Orientation on the Electronic Properties of PbS Quantum Dots
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: The electronic properties of quantum dots, such as band structure and work function, are highly sensitive to the composition and surface orientation. Based on the first-principles calculation method, the most stable configurations of PbS quantum dots with various stoichiometric ratios were established first through energy calculation in this paper. Then the variation trends and mechanisms of electronic properties of PbS quantum dots with different stoichiometry and surface crystal orientation are analyzed by the energy, density of states (DOS), and charge characteristics in this paper. The DOS and charge analysis reveal that the band structures of PbS quantum dots are significantly affected by both stoichiometry and surface crystal orientation. The quantum dot exhibits the widest bandgap (1.94 eV) with no extrinsic states within the bandgap when the Pb to S ratio is 1:1. In cases of Pb-rich or S-rich, the appearance of extrinsic states caused by surface Pb and S atoms reduces the bandgap width and leads to the quantum dot exhibiting n-type or p-type characteristics. For quantum dots with exposed {111} crystal plane, the energy of the extrinsic states and the Fermi level decreases with increasing S atom proportion. Conversely, for quantum dots with exposed {100} crystal plane, the energy of the extrinsic states and the Fermi level contributed by the rich S atoms increases with increasing S atom proportion. The calculation results also demonstrate that the work function of Pb-rich quantum dots is lower than that of S-rich quantum dots. This research provides crucial theoretical insights into the understanding and manipulation of the electronic properties of quantum dots.

articleTitle: Advances in Narrowband and Broadband Detection Applications of Perovskite Photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: With the rapid development of perovskite materials in the field of photovoltaic cells, their excellent semiconductor properties and unique optoelectronic characteristics have attracted the attention of the entire optoelectronic field. In the realm of photodetectors, perovskites exhibit outstanding optoelectronic performance across a wide spectral range and demonstrate exceptional performance in narrowband detection when used as an active layer. This paper primarily introduces the development and application of perovskite photodetectors in both broadband and narrowband fields. In narrowband detection, high sensitivity at specific wavelengths can be achieved through charge collection narrowing (CCN) strategies and other optimization methods such as trap states assistance, charge separation reversion, and electro-shielding layers. In broadband detection, hybrid device structures and dimension regulation, such as the use of mixed heterojunctions and nanomaterials, can broaden the spectral response range and optimize stability. Finally, potential future development directions for improving stability and optimizing performance of perovskite photodetectors is perspectived, showcasing their potential in the optoelectronic field and providing suggestions and directions for further research.

articleTitle: Research on Physical Model and Simulation of 4.5kV Si IGBT Device Based on Gradient Field Ring Terminal
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: IGBT (Insulate Gate Bipolar Transistor) combines the high frequency and low on-state voltage characteristics of field-effect transistor and bipolar transistor, and is widely used in power electronics system. Due to the continuous expansion of the power market and the increasing application requirements, the importance of the research on the optimization of the physical model and design parameters of high voltage IGBT is still lacking. In this work, a 4.5kV Si-based IGBT structure based on a gradient field ring terminal structure is designed. On the basis of the physical mechanism for the device, the influence of relevant key structural parameters on the performance of the device, such as channel length, p-well doping level, gate oxide quality, etc., is further systematically analyzed. At the same time, the voltage performance of the device under the influence of temperature is also studied, and the corresponding optimization strategy is proposed.

articleTitle: A TCAD Study of Analog Figures of Merit of Ultrathin Body and Buried Oxide SOI MOSFETs with Non-LDD Source/Drain Extensions
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: A recently proposed ultrathin body and buried oxide (UTBB) SOl MOSFETs with non-LDD source/drain extensions, which are induced by embedded fixed charges within the BOX, is investigated for analog circuit applications. TCAD simulation shows that the proposed device exhibits superior characteristics in suppressing short-channel effects while concurrently achieving higher transconductance <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(g_{\mathfrak{m}})$</tex>, lower output conductance <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(g_{\mathrm{d}\mathrm{s}})$</tex> and higher intrinsic gain <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(A_{\mathrm{v}})$</tex>, as well as reduced kink current. In the proposed device, onset of the kink current effect occurs at a larger <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Vo\mathrm{s}$</tex> bias compared to the LDD device, besides, it has a weaker drain-induced barrier lowering effect. Both factors lead to a flat VDS region available in the output curve above the drain saturation voltage with lower <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$g_{\mathrm{d}\mathrm{s}}$</tex> obtained.

articleTitle: A Monte Carlo Analysis of Condensation Risk from Sensor Error in Magnetic Resonance (MR) Cabinet
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: In a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) cabinet cooling system, the temperature and humidity sensor (T/H sensor) is used to detect the temperature and relative humidity (RH) to worked out the specific humidity (SH) to judge whether anti-condensation system should be triggered. However, due to the unavoidable imprecision of the T/<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$H$</tex> sensor, the misestimation of actual SH may cause condensation damage or over-protection to the cooling system. This paper proposes a method to define a proper anti-condensation triggering SH threshold for MRI cabinet cooling system, which avoid the above mentioned two extreme conditions. The coolant temperature, ambient temperature and RH are assumed to follow normal distribution with the sensor-measured value as average <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mu)4$</tex> and sensor error as 3 times of standard deviation (3o), A Monte Carlo model was established to include these imprecisions and analyze the condensation risk probability without anti-condensation system triggered at a presupposed SH threshold. By selecting a threshold which makes the risk probability between 1 % and 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, the appropriate threshold can be determined. Through such a process, engineers can get an SH threshold for reference to avoid both condensation damage and over-protection due to T IH sensor imprecision in MRI cabinet.

articleTitle: Total Ionizing Dose Effect at Low Temperature in HfO2 MOS Capacitors Irradiated with Proton
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Symposium on Semiconductor and Electronic Technology (ISSET)
abstract: The total ionizing dose effect of HfO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>MOS capacitors was investigated using proton irradiation at room temperature (300 K) and low temperature (100 K).
